headline: Get Bolty
title: How to Get Bolty | Blitzwood Lightning Breaker | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Bolty is a Lightning Break Aniimo, and the place to hunt it is Blitzwood, where most of its spawns sit. Wild ones are around level forty. Bring Ice or Dark attacks, since both hit it for extra damage. To get Blazen you must defeat the Alpha Blazen, then evolve Bolty with a Roar Stone. Blazen is a strong breaker for any Lightning team. Do you run Blazen? Comment below!
description: Aniimo's Bolty is a Lightning Break Aniimo found mostly in Blitzwood at around level 40. Defeat the Alpha Blazen and use a Roar Stone to evolve it into Blazen.
